fusions.name: Overarm Nest
fusions.desc: Hurls a nest that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. The enemy it strikes is left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ham-Fisted Jab
fusions.desc: A heavy backhand that deals 13 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stung to Frenzy
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Riled Beyond Reason
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
